issue.title: [auth-v1 05/08] Implement single-use password recovery over SMTP (#142)

body:
Relay BB run pushed an update.

Pull request: #350

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Pushed branch `bb/relay-142-auth-v1-05-08-implement-single-use-pas-thr_8v5qpi8wxw` to origin.

## Summary

Implements single-use password recovery over SMTP (issue #142):

- **Migration** `0027_password_reset_tokens.sql`: new `password_reset_tokens` table (user FK, unique `token_hash`, `expires_at`, `consumed_at`, `created_at`), mirroring `sessions.token_hash`'s "only the hash persists" pattern.
- **`passwordResetStore.ts`**: DB access, including `consumePasswordResetToken` — a single atomic `UPDATE ... WHERE consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > now() RETURNING` that both requires and marks single-use consumption in one statement, closing the double-consume race.
- **`passwordResetActions.ts`**: `requestPasswordReset` (resolves identically for a known and an unknown email — no disclosure of account existence; generates a high-entropy token and emails a reset link only for a real account) and `resetPassword` (atomic consume, new Argon2id hash, deterministic `PasswordResetTokenError` reason of `invalid`/`expired`/`consumed`).
- **`passwordResetMail.ts`**: a new app-level SMTP mailer (`NodemailerPasswordResetMailer`), reusing the SMTP infrastructure pattern from #27, independent of the per-mailbox draft/Sent-folder workflow (which doesn't apply to a system notification with no owning mailbox item).
- **HTTP surface** in `authHandler.ts`: `POST /api/auth/password-reset/request` and `POST /api/auth/password-reset/consume`, wired into `serve.ts` with `APP_BASE_URL`/`SMTP_*` env config (falls back to a `noop` mailer that throws if SMTP isn't configured, rather than silently pretending to send).

## Test plan

- [x] Unit tests: 114 passed
- [x] Integration tests (real Postgres): 722 passed, including new coverage for token issuance/consumption, expiry, reuse rejection, and email-existence non-disclosure
- [x] E2E tests: 5 passed
- [x] Lint clean
- [x] Full workspace `tsc` build clean

Branch: `bb/relay-142-auth-v1-05-08-implement-single-use-pas-thr_8v5qpi8wxw`

This push addresses the code-review findings on PR #350:
- **High**: `resetPassword` now revokes every other active session for the user in the same transaction as the password write, so a session an attacker held before the reset can't outlive it.
- **Medium**: `requestPasswordReset` now caps reset-token issuance per account to 3 per rolling hour, silently no-op'ing past the cap (same response shape as an unknown email), preventing reset-email flooding.
- **Low**: the reset URL is now HTML-escaped in the emailed HTML body as defense in depth.

Added test coverage for the session-revocation and rate-limiting behavior. Build, lint, unit (114/114), integration (727/727), and e2e (5/5) all pass on this commit.

Pull request: #350

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Working tree was clean; pushed the pending commit (`bc7b305`).

Branch: `bb/relay-142-auth-v1-05-08-implement-single-use-pas-thr_8v5qpi8wxw`

This push resolves the medium-severity correctness finding from the latest review of PR #350: `resetPassword`'s signature previously accepted `Pool | PoolClient`, but its consume-token/update-password/revoke-sessions sequence is only atomic inside a caller-managed transaction — a bare `Pool` would auto-commit each statement independently, risking a token being consumed without the password actually changing on a later failure. The signature is now narrowed to `PoolClient` only, forcing every caller into a transaction (the HTTP handler already did this via `withTransaction`); the tests were updated to do the same.

Build, lint, unit (114/114), integration (727/727), and e2e (5/5) all pass on this commit.
